archetype_description: Authority, Clarity, Truth. High visibility for construction environments, minimizing glare while maximizing data readability on-site. Purely functional, no-nonsense.

component_rules.cards: Flat, pure white background (#FFFFFF). 1px solid #E2E8F0 border. Subtle shadow. Inner padding 16px to 24px.
component_rules.buttons: Primary buttons: High-vis Orange (#F97316) background, white text. Large tap targets (min 48px height) for gloved/working hands.
component_rules.inputs: Large padding (16px), thick borders on focus (2px solid #F97316). Clear labels above inputs.
component_rules.bottom_sheets: Use bottom-sheet architecture for task details, assignments, and filters instead of full-page transitions to keep Gantt context visible.
component_rules.navigation: Thumb-friendly bottom tab navigation (Projects, Team, Settings).
component_rules.gantt_chart: Horizontal ScrollView with sticky left column. Use distinct status colors (Green/Yellow/Red) for progress bars based on quoted vs logged hours.

motion_and_interaction.gestures: Implement swipe-to-action on task lists if possible (e.g., swipe to mark complete).
motion_and_interaction.haptics: Trigger light haptic feedback on major actions (saving template, logging hours, completing task) using expo-haptics.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Fast, functional transitions. Slide up for bottom sheets.

accessibility.tap_targets: Minimum 48x48 points for all interactive elements.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over primary orange or status colors meets minimum 3:1 contrast ratio.
accessibility.testing: All touchable elements must have testID attributes mapping to their function (e.g., testID='login-submit-btn').

images.description: Interior hallway under construction. Use with dark or dark-orange overlay for login/onboarding.
Black ladder near painted wall. Used as a fallback cover image for fitout projects.
Man wearing hard hat. Use as a placeholder avatar in team management list.

icons.style: Bold, clear, stroke-based icons. No intricate details to ensure visibility outdoors.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: This is an EXPO REACT NATIVE APP. DO NOT USE HTML, Tailwind CSS, or Web Shadcn/UI components.
Use standard React Native primitives: View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, TextInput, FlatList with StyleSheet.create.
Gantt Chart implementation: Build a custom Gantt view. Consider a horizontal ScrollView containing rows, where the left side is absolute/fixed or synchronized scrolling.
Login Flow: Simple name-based login (no passwords). Just one TextInput to enter name, save to AsyncStorage.
Staff Calculator: Auto-calculate needed staff by formula: (Quoted Hours) / (Duration in days * Working Hours per day). Respect schedule: Mon-Thu 9h, Fri 8h, Sat 6h (optional).

Project Templates: Pre-load templates for: Steel Partitions, Aluminium Joinery, Doors, Gib & Villa Board Linings, Plastering, Concealed Grid, 2-Way Grid & Tiles, Feature Linings. Support saving custom projects as templates.
Progress Indicators: Compare logged hours vs quoted hours per task. Green (Under time), Yellow (On track), Red (Over time). Use the status colors provided.
Holidays & Regional Location: Integrate NZ regional holidays logic that skips non-working days in Gantt.
Export: Provide a way to export data using expo-print (PDF) or sharing a CSV string via expo-sharing.
Testing: Add testID props to all interactive elements for automated testing (kebab-case, role-based, e.g., testID='login-button').
